title: The 3 biggest tech layoffs of 2026 and what they mean for developers

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The 3 biggest tech layoffs of 2026 were all driven by flawed AI protocols, not just numbers.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You’re ignoring the scale—each was over 10,000 jobs. Numbers matter when developers lose work.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Scale alone doesn’t define impact. The 3 layoffs targeted outdated tech, not just size.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But developers don’t care about outdated tech—they care about job security and real-world impact.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The 3 layoffs reshaped the industry, proving that numbers define the future, not just protocols.
